title: docs: the moe-proxy README's env list documents a MOE_DAEMON_PORT override the proxy never reads, calls MOE_PROJECT_PATH required although it defaults to the cwd, and omits five MOE_* variables the proxy does read
description:
Filed by defect hunt 11-03 #4 (task-130a6a5c). Evidence is from HEAD 430e4620, run in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout.

PROBLEM
packages/moe-proxy/README.md:47-56 ("## Environment Variables") is the proxy's env reference, and the npm page shows it. It disagrees with the code three ways.
1. README.md:51 says "`MOE_DAEMON_PORT` - Daemon port (default: read from .moe/daemon.json)". No code reads that variable.
   - `git grep -n MOE_DAEMON_PORT 430e4620 -- packages docs scripts moe-jetbrains moe-vscode` prints only README.md:51. It came in with the first README (1a5a36bb, Feb 2026) and was never implemented.
   - The port comes only from daemon.json: src/index.ts:501 `const daemonInfo = readDaemonInfoResult(projectPath);`, then `info.port` at :529 and :541, then :554 `new WebSocket(\`ws://${getDaemonHost()}:${port}/mcp\`)`. With no daemon.json, the proxy retries for about 5 minutes and exits 1 (:504-519).
   - A user who follows the README is silently ignored. With no daemon.json the proxy exits; with one, it dials the daemon.json port instead.
2. README.md:49 says "`MOE_PROJECT_PATH` - Project path (required)". But src/utils.ts:162 has `return path.resolve(process.env.MOE_PROJECT_PATH || process.cwd());`, so it defaults to the cwd. docs/CONFIGURATION.md:36 already says "Current directory".
3. The list omits five variables the proxy does read:
   - MOE_WORKER_ID (src/index.ts:731, injectWorkerId; semantics at src/utils.ts:200-215);
   - MOE_RUNNER_PROCESS_STARTED_AT and MOE_RUNNER_HOST (src/index.ts:732, injectRunnerIdentity; semantics at src/utils.ts:250-260);
   - MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS (src/index.ts:40, `parsePositiveIntEnv(process.env.MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS, 30000)`);
   - MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE (src/index.ts:83; semantics at src/utils.ts:455-470: `underscore` exposes `moe_<name>` for grok, anything else is `dot`).

EVIDENCE
- Repro: `cd /tmp/hunt-130a-B/packages/moe-proxy && npx vitest run src/hunt-daemon-port.test.ts src/hunt-daemon-port-control.test.ts`. The test spawns the proxy through tsx against a .moe/ with no daemon.json, MOE_DAEMON_PORT set to a ws server on port 0, and one tools/call on stdin. Verbatim output:
  ```
  MOE_DAEMON_PORT=46783; daemon connections=0; frames received=0
  × connects to the daemon on MOE_DAEMON_PORT when daemon.json is absent
  ```
  Proxy stderr: `[moe-proxy] Daemon not running, retrying in 1156ms (attempt 1)` ... `(attempt 3)`.
  The control is the same harness with the port in daemon.json instead. It passes: `Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)`.
- Saved in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-130a/B/: hunt-daemon-port.test.ts, hunt-daemon-port-control.test.ts, daemon-port-repro.txt, daemon-port-control.txt.
- Mechanical check, which prints 6 difference lines at HEAD:
  ```
  diff <(grep -rhoE 'MOE_[A-Z_]+' packages/moe-proxy/src --include=*.ts --exclude=*.test.ts | sort -u) <(sed -n '/^## Environment Variables/,/^## One-shot/p' packages/moe-proxy/README.md | grep -oE 'MOE_[A-Z_]+' | sort -u)
  ```

FIX DIRECTION
This is docs-only. Edit packages/moe-proxy/README.md's Environment Variables list:
- Delete the MOE_DAEMON_PORT line. Don't implement the override in this row. The connection is deliberately keyed on daemon.json plus the /health identity probe (src/index.ts:529-541), so a port override would need its own design.
- Change MOE_PROJECT_PATH to say it defaults to the current directory.
- Add one line each for MOE_WORKER_ID, MOE_RUNNER_PROCESS_STARTED_AT plus MOE_RUNNER_HOST, MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS (default 30000) and MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE. Describe each from the code lines cited above. Several are launcher-set: say so, as the MOE_PROXY_ONESHOT_DEADLINE_MS line already does ("Wrapper-only").

Out of scope: any src change, docs/MCP_SERVER.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md and the README's other sections.

FILES: packages/moe-proxy/README.md (only).
definitionOfDone: `git grep -n MOE_DAEMON_PORT HEAD -- packages docs scripts moe-jetbrains moe-vscode` prints nothing (the README line is deleted, and no code was added for it)

From the repo root, `diff <(grep -rhoE 'MOE_[A-Z_]+' packages/moe-proxy/src --include=*.ts --exclude=*.test.ts | sort -u) <(sed -n '/^## Environment Variables/,/^## One-shot/p' packages/moe-proxy/README.md | grep -oE 'MOE_[A-Z_]+' | sort -u)` prints nothing and exits 0. That means the list names exactly the MOE_* variables the proxy's non-test sources read
The MOE_PROJECT_PATH line no longer says "(required)" and states the current-directory default (src/utils.ts:162), and MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS states its 30000 default (src/index.ts:40)
The diff against the merge base touches only packages/moe-proxy/README.md, and only lines inside its "## Environment Variables" section
